add_tridentnet_config: add TridentNet config options to a Detectron2 CfgNode with branch dilations and stage settings
configure_trident_branches: configure the number of TridentNet branches and their dilation rates for multi-scale feature extraction
set_trident_stage: set the TridentNet stage to res4 for applying trident blocks in the backbone
set_test_branch_idx: set the test branch index for fast TridentNet inference using a single branch
review_add_tridentnet_config: review the add_tridentnet_config function to understand TridentNet configuration defaults for NUM_BRANCH and BRANCH_DILATIONS
